import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
              'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
grouped = df.groupby('Response')[categories].mean().reset_index()

response_0 = grouped.loc[grouped['Response'] == 0, categories].values[0]
response_1 = grouped.loc[grouped['Response'] == 1, categories].values[0]

N = len(categories)
ind = np.arange(N)
width = 0.35

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
plt.bar(ind - width/2, response_0, width, 
        label='Did Not Respond (0)', color='#1f77b4', alpha=0.8)
plt.bar(ind + width/2, response_1, width, 
        label='Responded (1)', color='#ff7f0e', alpha=0.8)

plt.title('Average Spending by Product Category\n(Responded vs Did Not Respond)', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Average Spending (€)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(ind, [cat.replace('Mnt', '') for cat in categories], rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.legend(loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))
plt.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.5)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
